##### Project general facts

Elemental 22 is a boutique residential building developed in collaboration with Al Barari and inspired by titanium and the qualities it represents. The facade combines aluminium cladding with a titanium finish, warm wooden elements and lush vertical landscaping, creating a distinctive contemporary statement. The building rises above a ground floor and a three-level podium to seven residential floors and a rooftop with lounge areas, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments designed for refined everyday living.

Amenities bring together wellness, work and leisure. Residents can enjoy a rooftop swimming pool with a pool deck and panoramic city views, a fully equipped fitness centre and a Pilates studio. A recovery lounge with a sauna and steam room supports rest and renewal, while The Greenhouse coworking space offers a calm setting for focused work. A cinema room, a kids' play club, a lounge area and The Mill Cafe complete a lifestyle centred on comfort, community and balance.

Interiors are defined by spacious layouts, an abundance of natural light and open terraces that extend living areas outdoors. Travertine finishes add timeless elegance and a calm, natural character to living spaces and bathrooms. Kitchens are fitted with quality appliances and clean, practical cabinetry for everyday cooking and entertaining. Bedrooms offer quiet, private retreats, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Garden City is a central residential district of Dubai, located between Al Satwa, Al Wasl and the Sheikh Zayed Road corridor. The area combines a calm, low-rise neighbourhood character with immediate access to the city's main business and leisure destinations. City Walk and the Dubai Water Canal lie close by, offering dining, retail and waterfront promenades within easy reach of residents.

Sheikh Zayed Road connects the district directly with Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Financial Centre and The Dubai Mall, all a short drive away. Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates are also within easy reach, and Dubai International Airport is a convenient drive away. Schools, clinics, supermarkets and the beaches of Jumeirah complete the everyday offer around the neighbourhood.

Jumeirah Garden City is a freehold area open to international buyers. Its central position between Downtown Dubai and the coast supports steady demand from professionals and families seeking a well-connected address. Low-rise planning, proximity to major business hubs and the lifestyle offer of City Walk give the district a distinctive position and strong long-term appeal for both end users and investors.
